evidence.name: Screen field: Text box height and position
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Text box height and position" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Text box height and position
sections.description: Controls the box that holds all of a slide's text (title, subtitle, detail) as a group, separate from styling each line. Set how tall the box is (Auto fits the text, Fixed is exact pixels, Percent is a share of the slide), where the text block sits, and the padding around it. Leave it on Auto unless you want text anchored the same way on every slide, for example always sitting in the lower third over the image.
